ask: What is this page for?

Your records stay on your device, in the browser. They are not uploaded unless you choose to use encrypted sync. With that option, your data is encrypted on your device before it is synced, so the server cannot read your plans, habits, or health entries.

The app connects goals, habits, and health records. Goals track targets and progress, while habits help you build or quit specific actions. Health records your daily diary, water, weight, and steps. Wealth tracks your holdings and accounts without converting between currencies.

I am your own personal AI. I run on your own provider, and ZIGoals does not see our conversation. I can propose records to be added as cards, but I cannot move money or change your settings myself.

To change any settings, you can go to Settings and look for the ZIGi section.
